name: io.github.Cookiebreed/card-recognition-mcp
title: NeoSatoshi Card Recognition
description: Identify trading cards in a photo, search and correct them, with Cardmarket prices.

environmentVariables.name: NEOSATOSHI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your NeoSatoshi API key. Optional: without it the public demo key is used (10 detections per day per network).

environmentVariables.name: NEOSATOSHI_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Optional list of directories the server may read images from, separated by ':' (';' on Windows). Unset means any readable image file.
